# Theme configuration

## Current approach

Today, theming is handled through two mechanisms:

### 1. Carbon theme selection

Choose a Carbon theme for your application's light or dark appearance:

```tsx
import { Theme } from '@carbon/react';

function App() {
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState(false);

  return (
    <Theme theme={isDark ? 'g100' : 'white'}>
      <AppHeader appTitle="My App" orgName="SLAC" />
      <Content>
        {/* Application content */}
      </Content>
    </Theme>
  );
}
```

### 2. Component props

Pass organization-specific values directly to components:

```tsx
<AppHeader
  orgName="SLAC"
  appTitle="Experiment Dashboard"
  logo={<img src="/slac-logo.svg" alt="SLAC" height={20} />}
  navItems={[
    { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
    { label: 'Data', href: '/data' },
  ]}
/>
```

## Available Carbon themes

| Theme | Description |
|---|---|
| `white` | Light theme with white backgrounds |
| `g10` | Light theme with subtle gray backgrounds |
| `g90` | Dark theme with dark gray backgrounds |
| `g100` | Dark theme with near-black backgrounds |

## Future: theme presets

:::info Planned
A structured theme preset system is planned that will allow organizations to define a configuration object combining:

- Organization name and logo
- Preferred Carbon theme
- Optional accent color tokens

This will simplify setup for adopting teams. Design and API are not yet decided.
:::
